title: Build a Claim with Evidence
prompt: Use these steps when you need to explain why a material belongs in a group.

steps.title: Name the rule
steps.content: Start with the property or criterion you are using, such as **absorbency**, **magnetism**, or **flexibility**.

steps.title: State the claim
steps.content: Say where the material belongs. Example: **I classify the sponge as absorbent.**

steps.title: Add evidence
steps.content: Use an observation or test result. Example: **It soaked up water during the test.**

steps.title: Say it as one strong answer
steps.content: **I classify the sponge as absorbent because it soaked up water during the test.**

fallback.markdown: Strong science explanations use a claim and evidence. First name the rule, then say the group, then add the observation or test result that supports the answer.
